description.en: Uploads the documents this conversation produced — Markdown notes, PDFs, Office files — into your local Zotero library, and reads your library back: search items, inspect metadata, extract PDF full text, resolve attachment paths, and export BibTeX/RIS. Talks to Zotero's built-in local server on 127.0.0.1:23119 — no API key and nothing to install inside Zotero. Upload rows sit beside each turn's deliverables plus a composer chip; the /zotero command and the zotero_sync / zotero_library tools cover everything. Unchanged files are skipped instead of duplicated.
description.zh: 把对话中产出的文档（Markdown 笔记、PDF、Office 文件）上传到本机 Zotero 文库，并可只读检索文库文献：搜索条目、读元数据、提取 PDF 全文、拿附件本地路径，还能导出 BibTeX/RIS。走 Zotero 自带的本地服务 127.0.0.1:23119，无需 API Key，也不用在 Zotero 里装任何东西。上传入口在每回合交付物旁与输入框快捷按钮，/zotero 指令与 zotero_sync / zotero_library 工具覆盖全部能力；内容未变化的文件自动跳过而不重复建条目。
